title: GR180 D2R PMG sizing (front pod, 115k rpm)

rating.note: rated = 30 C site (turbine study 25.9 kW shaft); peak 31 kW at 15 C chilled intake; above that limit TIT / power

geometry.jacket: Al 6082-T6 sleeve ID 88 / OD 98 with a 3 mm deep helical glycol groove, pressed in the pod bore 98, 2 O-rings each end

magnetics.winding: 3-ph double layer, 12 coils x 5 turns, 5/6 pitch, Litz 0.1 mm strands, class H, vacuum-potted

cooling.rotor: rotor heat (eddy + half the windage) crosses the gap to the stator; magnet ~130-150 C (est) - Sm2Co17 good to 300 C

rotor.build: Sm2Co17 ring segments (2 halves x 4 axial pieces, diametral magnetisation), bonded on the d20 carrier; T700 carbon sleeve wound with pre-tension or pressed on a 1:200 taper; Ti6Al4V end rings; balance G1 as an assembly

converter.type: 4-quadrant machine-side AFE (motoring start), sensorless FOC, f_out >= 2 kHz, f_sw >= 24 kHz (SiC)
